children: Wynn Resorts, through Wynn Resorts Finance and Wynn Resorts Capital, entered into an indenture and issued $900 million of 6.875% senior notes due March 15, 2035. Interest is payable semi-annually each March 15 and September 15, starting March 15, 2027. Net proceeds, along with cash on hand, will redeem in full the 5.250% Wynn Las Vegas notes due 2027 and cover related fees and expenses. The notes carry subsidiary guarantees and include customary covenants, redemption options, and change-of-control protections.
: Senior notes indenture for 6.875% notes due 2035
: Refinance 2027 WLV notes and cover related fees
